name: Account lost, hacked or family-plan access
model_suggested_name: Locked out of account due to ads
model_description: The customer reports being blocked from their account, and also complains about excessive ads.

name: Login, logout and password problems
model_suggested_name: Password rejected at login
model_description: The customer reports the app will not accept their password when signing in.

name: Other billing complaints
model_suggested_name: Vague billing complaints about restrictions and unrelated content
model_description: Customers report general frustration with restrictions or post unrelated, non-billing text that does not describe a specific billing problem.

name: Features locked behind Premium (skips, song choice, playback)
model_suggested_name: Basic playback features locked behind Premium subscription
model_description: Free users report that skipping, song choice, and other basic playback features were removed or restricted unless they pay for Premium.

name: Other catalog complaints
model_suggested_name: Songs and music genres missing from catalog
model_description: Customers report that many songs and certain genres, such as gospel music, are not available in the catalog.

name: Lyrics missing or broken
model_suggested_name: Lyrics inconsistently missing or not displayed
model_description: Customers report that lyrics fail to show for some songs while appearing for others, making the feature unreliable.

name: Recommendations, repeats and smart features
model_suggested_name: Unwanted recommendations and suggestions
model_description: Customers are frustrated by excessive or unwanted song recommendations appearing in the app.

name: Downloads fail or won't start
model_suggested_name: Song downloads stall until app is reopened
model_description: Customers report that downloads get stuck in the background and only resume or complete after they reopen Spotify.

name: Offline mode not working
model_suggested_name: Offline playback not functioning for downloaded music
model_description: Customers report that offline mode does not work, so downloaded content cannot be played without a connection.

name: Boycott / political protest with a complaint or departure
model_suggested_name: Boycott over Quran burning and Swedish politics
model_description: Customers say they are uninstalling Spotify and boycotting it in protest over Quran burnings linked to Sweden.

name: General dissatisfaction, no specific product issue
model_suggested_name: Vague dissatisfaction after recent updates
model_description: Customers express general dislike of the app or recent updates without naming any specific product problem.

name: Connection, Bluetooth, car and devices
model_suggested_name: Playback fails on Wi-Fi and poor audio quality
model_description: Customers report the app cannot connect to the internet over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and song audio quality is poor.

name: App crashes / won't open
model_suggested_name: App crashes after update and won't open
model_description: Customers report the app crashes or fails to open after a recent update.

name: Other playback problems (bugs, not working)
model_suggested_name: Cannot skip back or seek within tracks
model_description: Customers report they cannot go back a few seconds or otherwise navigate within a playing song.

name: Lag, slowness, battery and loading
model_suggested_name: App stuck on loading or logo screen
model_description: Customers report the app gets stuck on the loading or logo screen and does not proceed.

name: Music stops, pauses or cuts out
model_suggested_name: Music stops halfway and doesn't resume position
model_description: Customers report playback stops partway through songs and does not resume where it left off, starting a new song instead.

name: Songs won't play / app not working / bugs
model_suggested_name: Songs won't play, features and bugs broken
model_description: Customers report songs will not play, specific features like repeat, adjustment, or Google Assistant control fail, and various bugs persist after an update.

name: Customer support contact and response
model_suggested_name: Rude and hostile customer support staff
model_description: The customer says the app's support staff were rude, and the review includes an unrelated, offensive remark about LGBTQ users.

name: Ad frequency, length and loudness
model_suggested_name: Excessive ad frequency and loudness for free users
model_description: Free-tier users report that ads play too often, too loudly, and make the app unusable without a premium subscription.

name: Playlist, queue and library management
model_suggested_name: Cannot skip through long unwanted playlists
model_description: A user reports being forced to get through a long playlist with very limited skips just to reach the song they want.

name: New update / redesign / navigation and layout
model_suggested_name: Disliked update removed features and changed homescreen
model_description: Users complain that recent updates removed basic music player features and replaced the homescreen with a feed-style layout they find unwelcome.
